_about: Hand-written fixes, applied after the MeSH mapping. mesh: applies to every trial whose primary MeSH is that id. trial: applies to one trial. add = SNOMED concepts to add (patient codes match if they are the concept or below it). drop_mapping = ignore the automatic mapping for this trial. rule = a measurement rule the engine can run instead of, or as well as, codes.
